question: On 200 observations never used before, does catalogue version 2 leave fewer observations without a label, and does Clef's top three still contain the right label?
decision: Whether OMMS adopts catalogue version 2, and whether Clef's top three is confirmed as the review-queue suggestion list.

H1.statement: Share of scored new observations with final reference none_fit <= 0.35 under catalogue version 2.

H2.statement: Clef top three (by probability, none_fit excluded) contains the reference label for >= 0.90 of labelled new observations.

H3.statement: Clef first-pick accuracy, none_fit recognition, use of the 15 new labels.

hypotheses.H0: For H1 and H2, the threshold is not met.

decision_rule.H2: Clef top three confirmed as the suggestion list in ADR-024.
decision_rule.fail: Keep the current choice and report why.

gates.G1_integrity: all pins verify before and after
gates.G2_privacy: every selected text passes the exclusion rules
gates.G3_blindness: reference hashed before the first Clef call; labellers see no model output
gates.G4_completeness: 200 valid Clef answers; errors count as wrong
gates.G5_label_quality: passes agree >= 0.75 before reconciliation; failure makes validity INCONCLUSIVE

selection.rules: Experiment 18 select_cases.py exclusion_reason and duplicate rule, pinned
selection.excluded_ids: Experiment 01 ground truth (200) and Experiment 18 fresh cases (400)

frozen.gallery: Experiment 01 200 labelled cases plus Experiment 18 400 final labels mapped to version 2 (102 accepted-label members relabelled; disputed excluded)
frozen.labelling: Experiment 18 protocol against catalogue version 2 (56 labels)
